logs.scope: First observed admission in a complete log; input length filter excludes warmup. Log timestamps have one-second resolution, not kernel timing.
logs.limitations: Subsequent cached-token counts are chunk progress, not reusable prefix hits. Not observed admitted is not proof of never computed. Prompt-end scheduling is not GPU completion. Does not measure decode stall duration.
